title: prunus × lannesiana f. caespitosa
intro: Prunus × lannesiana f. caespitosa, commonly known as Japanese Flowering Cherry or Japanese Weeping Cherry, is a compact, deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Prunus × lannesiana f. caespitosa include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, due to limited research, more studies are required to fully understand the bioactive constituents and their effects on human health.
